note: Scales revenue by 0.75 for EVERY row of fact_sessions on the target date, uniformly across every channel/device/country cell; sessions and transactions held everywhere. Implemented in evaluation/injector.py's _scale_uniform.
dates_revision: unchanged 2026-09-27 -- verified via full injection simulation that the revised, percentile-based condition transfers cleanly on all 5 original dates. No re-screen needed.

pass_condition.description: For each dimension (channel, device, country), the injected date's max |actual-expected|-share among that dimension's segments must fall within the empirically measured real (no-injection) noise distribution for that dimension -- below its ~90th-95th percentile, not an assumed absolute tolerance.

pass_condition_revision: revised 2026-09-27, the hardest of I1/I2/I3/I4/I5/I6/I7's fixes: the original '+/-10pt of baseline revenue share' and 'CONCENTRATED must NOT fire' both failed on every one of the 5 original dates when actually simulated (max channel within-share 44.7%-339.7%; CONCENTRATED false-fired 5/5 -- logged separately as its own risk, notes/PLAN.md Section 8, since CONCENTRATED's own bug affects every real investigation, not just this benchmark). Neither the I1-style rank+sign fix (no single target segment for a uniform, everywhere cut) nor the I6-style verdict-only fix (AOV's verdict is always material_untested, never strong -- vacuous, can't distinguish broad from concentrated) transfers. Fix: measure the real noise distribution directly (the same move Section 3.5 already made for top-level detection) and check the injected date lands inside it. See notes/PLAN.md 5.2.
